name: DTEmpire Adventure
features: Daily login streak with escalating reward multipliers (up to 2x)
Live streak badge on the inventory page
Trading System - Player-to-player item and coin trading
Trade offers with items and coins
Bestiary discovery tracking with per-monster kill counts

notes: ⚔️ Bestiary Mastery now pays off in combat: each mastery rank on a monster grants +3 ATK and +2 DEF whenever you fight that monster (up to +12 ATK / +8 DEF at Nemesis).
The bonus is shown in your adventure combat log when it applies.
Bestiary page lists the exact ATK/DEF bonus next to every rank badge you have earned.
- By Hermes
🏅 Bestiary Mastery: every monster now has 4 mastery ranks (Novice 10 kills, Hunter 50, Slayer 200, Nemesis 500).
Reaching a rank pays coins instantly (250 / 1,500 / 8,000 / 30,000) and sends a mail notice — each rank awards only once.
Existing kill counts carry over, so veteran hunters claim back-ranks on their next kill.
Bestiary page shows your rank badge next to each monster and boss.
- By Hermes
Achievements now unlock the moment you earn them — no need to open the Achievements page first.
Every unlock arrives as mail with its name, description and the +20 coin bonus.
Tower floor clears now check achievements too, so floor milestones unlock correctly.
Fixed: achievement names were being recorded twice, cluttering your unlocked list.
- By Hermes
Bestiary is now a living record — every monster you defeat is permanently logged.
Undefeated creatures show dimmed and marked 'undiscovered' until you slay one.
Each defeated monster and boss shows a personal kill counter (⚔ N slain).
New discovery progress line at the top: Discovered X / Y creatures.
Fixed: adventure victories were not counting toward 'total_wins', so win-based achievements never unlocked.
- By Hermes
Daily Login Streak — claim the daily reward on consecutive days to build a streak.
Streak rewards scale: 3 days = x1.25, 7 = x1.5, 14 = x1.75, 30+ = x2 coins and XP.
Every 7th day in a row grants a bonus streak chest (1,000 coins x weeks completed).
A streak survives a 48h gap, so one late day is forgiven before it resets.
New /api/daily/status endpoint and a live streak badge on the Inventory page.
- By Hermes

Fixed hybrid potions (Mirage Flask, Frostfire Mixture, Cosmic Convergence, Abyssal Convergence, Elixir of Forever, Deep Tide Potion) — these carry BOTH a heal and an XP bonus, but the shop only ever saved one of the two, so every hybrid potion bought was permanently missing half its value.

Fixed drinking potions — the XP effect was swallowed by the heal check, so XP-granting potions healed you and silently gave 0 XP. Heal and XP now both apply, and level-ups from potion XP are granted correctly.
- By Hermes

changes: 2 new monsters in Crystal Caverns: Diamond Wraith (+58 ATK) and Obsidian Guardian (+60 DEF)

notes: New shop item: ⚡ Primordius' Core (1,600,000 coins) — +4600 ATK & +4600 DEF & +26000 max HP permanently, top-tier upgrade beyond Astral Convergence for endgame players past Primordial Peak.
- By Hermes

Fixed Temple of Elders offering (/api/temple/offer) — endpoint validated amount but never processed the donation, causing coin offerings to silently fail with no response. Now correctly deducts coins, grants XP (amount/2), and applies level-ups.
- By Hermes

changes: New location: Primordial Peak (Lv.32+) — highest summit with Primordial Spark, Magma Titan, Storm Avatar, Cosmic Warden + Primordius, The First Born boss
Regenerated adventure_locations.json and guild_shops.json caches (fixed a stale corrupted guild_shops.json — items were flattened to strings, restored to full weapons/armor/potions/special dicts)
Dungeon UI zone selector updated with new Primordial Peak entry
Added Trading System (/trade page and API)
